backend/main.mo: Actor manages user profiles and commercial property records with access control, storage mixins, and multiple property filtering queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature requirements, associated frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing many frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and layout structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global background and text styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for public listings and agent pages within a themed layout.
frontend/src/components/agent/MultiPhoto: Image upload component handling multi-file image selection, progress tracking, preview display, and removal.
frontend/src/components/agent/PropertyFo: Form component for creating or editing a property listing with fields, validation, and image uploads.
frontend/src/components/auth/AgentProtec: Route guard that checks agent authorization and shows an access denied screen if unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthLoadErr: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer displaying copyright text and a Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Sticky header with site logo, navigation links, and an Agent Arena button.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Layout wrapper that renders the site header, footer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/listings/Contact: Button linking to a prefilled WhatsApp message to contact the agent about a property.
frontend/src/components/listings/Propert: Card displaying a property’s image, details, type badge, and navigation to the listing page.
Image gallery with a main display and thumbnail carousel allowing selection of images.
frontend/src/components/search/PropertyS: Search bar allowing filtering of properties by location, type, area, and price.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for handling Internet Identity login, persistence, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, roles, properties, and filtered property searches using an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode tokens, and component style utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentArenaEntry: Implements an agent login page where users enter a code to access the agent dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/agent/AgentDashboardP: Shows the agent dashboard with property stats, logout, and navigation to manage or add listings.
frontend/src/pages/agent/ManagePropertie: Lists all agent properties with options to add, edit, or delete, handling loading states and authorization errors.
frontend/src/pages/agent/PropertyEditorP: Provides a form to create or edit a property, loading existing data when editing and handling submission with error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed information for a single property, including images, stats, and agent contact options.
frontend/src/pages/PublicListingsPage.ts: Provides a public listings UI with search filters that fetch and display matching properties.
frontend/src/utils/agentCodeAuth.ts: Implements simple agent code authorization using localStorage with verify, check, clear, and retrieval utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL or session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, architecture, issues, and requirements for the commercial property portal.
